verdict.rationale: n8n is fundamentally an event-driven automation platform with triggers (webhooks, schedule, MCP server trigger, app-event triggers) that fire workflows automatically, plus error workflows to control follow-up actions on failure — directly matching 'rules that trigger actions on events.' This is corroborated by hands-on community use (subreddit scraping triggers, webhook-initiated backend tasks) confirming real-world automation behavior. Missing for 10: no independent benchmark of trigger reliability at scale or deeper docs on complex conditional rule logic beyond basic IF/switch nodes.
